response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), timing_groups AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_group_avg, AVG(g.group_avg - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM timing_groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.overall_avg
